Q1: What should the unattended implementation deliver, given that it can't write `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`?
Choices:
A) Record the operator step only. Add `WRAPPED_GIT_WRITE_GUARD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP` as an unresolved placeholder, add an `agents.md` note naming the human step (both hook copies, tests against both, changelog fragment) and the finding as still open, and add a changelog fragment for that. Make no hook code changes. A person then makes the hook change in a trusted checkout. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Change the template copy only, with the new check off unless `WRAPPED_GIT_WRITE_GUARD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP` is set. Add tests, docs and a changelog fragment, and add a temporary `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json` entry with a reason so parity CI passes. A person copies the change to the live hook later and removes the entry.
C) Change the template copy only and rely on the held `ai/sync-claude-live-copies-held` draft PR for the live copy. Do not add an allowlist entry. **Note:** CI requires the committed live security hook to match the template, so this PR would stay red and unmergeable until a person merges the held sync PR.
D) Close this fix-up as `BLOCKED` and leave #6755 for a person. The pipeline makes no changes.
